cohort: 926 pregnant women with a positive test for SARS-CoV-2
finding: Pregnant women with pulmonary comorbidities, hypertensive disorders, and diabetes were at higher risk of developing severe complications of SARS-CoV-2 infection, leading to increased risk of caesarean section, preterm delivery, and neonatal intensive care unit admission.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with severe COVID-19 were at higher risk of cesarean section compared to those with milder disease (70.7% vs. not reported).
